steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Disconnect compressor terminals
steps.body: Disconnect power. Remove start module and disconnect compressor wires.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Remove start module and disconnect compressor wires.

steps.title: Identify common terminal
steps.body: Ohm all three terminal pairs. Highest reading = start + run in series; remaining terminal is common (C).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Ohm all three terminal pairs. Highest reading = start + run in series; remaining terminal is common (C).

steps.title: Identify run and start windings
steps.body: Meter on common: lower of the two remaining readings = run (R); other = start (S).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Meter on common: lower of the two remaining readings = run (R); other = start (S).

steps.title: Winding-to-ground check
steps.body: Each terminal to ground/chassis must read infinity — any low reading indicates internal short.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace compressor — winding shorted to ground.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Each terminal to ground/chassis must read infinity — any low reading indicates internal short.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace compressor — winding shorted to ground.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Top-Mount Refrigerator Job Aid (W10330404 R-111)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Access condenser fan
steps.body: Remove machine compartment cover. Disconnect condenser fan motor wires. Static condenser models have no fan — skip if not equipped.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove machine compartment cover. Disconnect condenser fan motor wires. Static condenser models have no fan — skip if not equipped.

steps.title: Motor type check
steps.body: Shaded-pole motors can be ohm-tested (~700 Ω). Stepper motors cannot — use 120 VAC functional test only.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Shaded-pole motors can be ohm-tested (~700 Ω). Stepper motors cannot — use 120 VAC functional test only.

steps.title: Condenser fan winding resistance
steps.body: Measure across motor leads — shaded pole example ~700 Ω. OL indicates open winding.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure across motor leads — shaded pole example ~700 Ω. OL indicates open winding.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Top-Mount Refrigerator Job Aid (W10330404 R-111)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Access defrost bimetal
steps.body: Remove evaporator cover. Disconnect bimetal harness. Test at harness terminals with power off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove evaporator cover. Disconnect bimetal harness. Test at harness terminals with power off.

steps.title: Evaporator frost state
steps.body: Is the evaporator frosted and the bimetal cold (below ~40°F)? Warm bimetal should read open (infinity).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Is the evaporator frosted and the bimetal cold (below ~40°F)? Warm bimetal should read open (infinity).

steps.title: Defrost bimetal resistance (cold)
steps.body: Frosted evaporator and cold bimetal: expect <1 Ω closed. Open when warm after defrost is normal.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Frosted evaporator and cold bimetal: expect <1 Ω closed. Open when warm after defrost is normal.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Top-Mount Refrigerator Job Aid (W10330404 R-111)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Access defrost heater
steps.body: Remove evaporator cover. Disconnect defrost heater wiring harness at the heater.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove evaporator cover. Disconnect defrost heater wiring harness at the heater.

steps.title: Defrost heater resistance
steps.body: Measure across heater terminals. Example: ~30 Ω installed, ~33 Ω uninstalled (verify tech sheet).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure across heater terminals. Example: ~30 Ω installed, ~33 Ω uninstalled (verify tech sheet).

steps.title: Heater sheath isolation
steps.body: One lead on heater wire, other on heater sheath — must read infinity (no short to ground).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace defrost heater — element shorted to sheath.

steps.sourceExcerpt: One lead on heater wire, other on heater sheath — must read infinity (no short to ground).

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace defrost heater — element shorted to sheath.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Access defrost timer
steps.body: Locate mechanical defrost timer (typically refrigerator compartment). Disconnect power before contact checks.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Locate mechanical defrost timer (typically refrigerator compartment). Disconnect power before contact checks.

steps.title: Timer in cooling position — contacts 1–2 and 1–4
steps.body: With timer in cooling: pins 1–2 = 0 Ω; pins 1–4 = OL. Rotate timer shaft until it snaps into defrost and recheck.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace defrost timer — cooling contacts failed.

steps.sourceExcerpt: With timer in cooling: pins 1–2 = 0 Ω; pins 1–4 = OL. Rotate timer shaft until it snaps into defrost and recheck.

steps.title: Timer in defrost position — contacts 1–2 and 1–4
steps.body: With timer in defrost: pins 1–2 = OL; pins 1–4 = 0 Ω. ~8 hr run / ~20 min defrost typical.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace defrost timer — defrost contacts failed.

steps.sourceExcerpt: With timer in defrost: pins 1–2 = OL; pins 1–4 = 0 Ω. ~8 hr run / ~20 min defrost typical.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace defrost timer — cooling contacts failed.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: Replace defrost timer — defrost contacts failed.

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Remove ice maker
steps.body: Remove ice maker from freezer. Unplug ice maker from refrigerator harness. Depress locking tab to remove wire harness from housing.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove ice maker from freezer. Unplug ice maker from refrigerator harness. Depress locking tab to remove wire harness from housing.

steps.title: Harness thermal fuse resistance
steps.body: Ohm across thermal fuse in harness (normally black wire) — 0 Ω closed. OL = open fuse.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Ohm across thermal fuse in harness (normally black wire) — 0 Ω closed. OL = open fuse.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Top-Mount Refrigerator Job Aid (W10330404 R-111)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Allow PTC cool-down
steps.body: Disconnect power. Allow PTC to cool ~10 minutes if compressor was recently run — hot PTC reads open.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Allow PTC to cool ~10 minutes if compressor was recently run — hot PTC reads open.

steps.title: Disconnect start device
steps.body: Remove machine compartment cover. Unplug start module from compressor. Do not rapid-cycle during service.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove machine compartment cover. Unplug start module from compressor. Do not rapid-cycle during service.

steps.title: PTC cold resistance
steps.body: Measure PTC at room temperature — ~5 Ω cold; rises to 100kΩ+ within 1–3 s when energized.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure PTC at room temperature — ~5 Ω cold; rises to 100kΩ+ within 1–3 s when energized.
